Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment tests I2, which must performed on yearly bases as indicated by 
 Y1 in the titled block
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah Kamel Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. 
Sahar Mohamed Ali, accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hussein Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.
Current transformer must be isolated and proper grounded is required
Wear safety 
 belt because there is danger of falling off the top of the CT stack when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections.
Presence the safety 
 supervisor is required.
Caution: Secondary CT wiring could be energized 
 through back feeds, make sure circuit breaker to secondary circuit is
 short circuited.
Tools 
and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, and silicagel
Safety helmet, safety belt, and silicagel
Voltage indicator.
Tool set for tightness,
Cleaning tools as cloth, rags .... etc
Fiberglass ladder
Works to be Carried Out
Check out the condition of the expansion diaphragm.
Open secondary terminal compartment, blow out compartment and check the 
 condition of the weather seal.
Check that all wiring terminations are tight and securely fastened.
Check the condition of cables or conduits entering the secondary terminal
 compartment.
Check earth bus connections to base of CT for tightness.
Touch up painting if required.
